items.text: Choosing between CA and law depends on whether you prefer working with numbers, compliance and audit or with arguments, documents and disputes, since both are long, exam-heavy paths with different daily work, entry routes and ways to build a practice.
Test both with a small task: reconcile a set of sample accounts for one, and read a short contract or case note and summarise the issue for the other.
Check the official bodies and institutions before you enrol.
